title: griffin1
summary: Best option: land at Nobile rim 2 on 2027-02-07 12:00 UTC (GREEN, worst case GREEN). Sunlight 100-100% of the mission, Earth contact 99%, longest darkness 0 h.

landing.shadow_risk: Sun -1.7 deg, below the local horizontal (visible only because the site is high): any local depression is in shadow. Craters smaller than about 10 m are not resolved by the 5 m terrain: check the ellipse with 1 m imagery (IM-2 Athena, 2025, ended in a 20 m crater).
